name: dms-pfe
description: AI-Powered DMS — fullstack React + Express + PostgreSQL (Neon).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --host"
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:setup && npm start
